\begin{example} \end{example}[Simplicial homology of the torus] ↗ lem:boundary-composition-zero 1. ch2:2.3\group Singular Homology

For the one-vertex, three-edge, two-triangle structure on $T$, $\partial _1=0$ and $\partial _2U=\partial _2L=a+b-c$. Thus \[ H_n^\Delta (T)\cong \begin{cases} \mathbb {Z}& n=0,2,\\ \mathbb {Z}\oplus \mathbb {Z}& n=1,\\ 0& n\geq 3.\end{cases} \] The classes of $a,b$ generate $H_1^\Delta (T)$ and $U-L$ generates $H_2^\Delta (T)$. \end{example}
